data.name: Kenan
data.gender_notes: Kenan is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Kenan means 'Jehovah's gift'. In the Old Testament, Kenan is the name of a descendant of Adam and the father of Mahalalel. In the New Testament, a Kenan appears in the genealogy of Jesus Christ. The name Kenan carries the meaning “Jehovah's gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Kenan usually hope their child will grow to embody jehovah's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Kenan belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jehovah's gift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kenan total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_greek.name: Κέναν
in_greek.meaning: ὄνομα ἀνδρὸς, ὄνομα ὃ μορφοῦται ἀπὸ σλαβική
in_greek.long_meaning: Ὁ Κέναν ἐστὶν ὄνομα ἀνδρὸς, ἡ ἀπὸ σλαβικῆς γλώσσης ἀπευθυνόμενη ὑπὸ τῶν Ἑλλήνων, ἀπὸ τῆς Ἑβραϊκῆς ἔμψυχης ὀνοματοδοσίας, τῆς ὁποίας σήμανε τοὺς κατέχοντας ἐξουσίας

in_latin.name: Kenan
in_latin.long_meaning: Kenan est nomen viri, radix significativa servitutis, ex Hebraico oriens, in Ecclesia Christiana usus, et in historiae culturae tractatus

in_english.name: Kenan
in_english.meaning: a wise man, name of biblical figure, associated with wisdom and understanding
in_english.long_meaning: Kenan is a name of a biblical figure, meaning wise or wise man, originating from the Hebrew root, with biblical references in the book of Genesis, associated with wisdom, understanding, and the early Christian church tradition

data.cultural_impact: The name Kenan has a rich cultural history that connects it to the biblical tradition. It is a unique and meaningful name, rooted in the ancient Hebrew language and the stories of the Old and New Testaments. It is a name that carries a sense of heritage and connection to the past, as well as a reminder of the continued influence of biblical stories and figures in our modern world.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Kenan holds great spiritual significance as it is a reminder of the gift of life and the blessings bestowed upon us by God. It is a name that invites us to reflect on the sacredness of our existence and to give thanks for the blessings we have received. It also serves as a reminder of the continuity of faith and the eternal nature of God's love and grace, as evidenced by the name's appearance in both the Old and New Testaments.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Kenan in Hebrew means "visitor" or "traveler." Spiritually, it signifies welcoming strangers with kindness and hospitality, reflecting God's love and grace towards all people.

biblical_reference.note: Kenan is a figure in the biblical genealogy of Seth

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that In the Bible, Kenan is mentioned as the son of Enosh and the father of Mahalaleel. The name Kenan carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Kenan is a biblical figure mentioned in the genealogy of Adam in the book of Genesis.

It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
